title: [XPU][XCCL] torch.distributed.all_to_all_single produces corrupted output on 4x B60
body:
## 🐛 Describe the bug

`torch.distributed.all_to_all_single` produces corrupted data on 4x Intel Arc Pro B60 (XCCL). The functional-collectives equivalent (`torch.distributed._functional_collectives.all_to_all_single`) works correctly on the same setup.

### Reproduction

```bash
# Run on XPU (4 GPUs)
export ZE_AFFINITY_MASK=0,1,2,3
torchrun --nproc_per_node=4 test_alltoall_single.py

# Test different dtypes
torchrun --nproc_per_node=4 test_alltoall_single.py --dtype bfloat16
```

Test 1 (simple small tensor) FAILs on 4 GPUs. Affects Ulysses attention in sglang-diffusion.

### Environment
- PyTorch 2.9.0+xpu, oneCCL 2021.16.1
- Intel Arc Pro B60 x4
- Container: intel/llm-scaler-omni:0.1.0-b6

### Walkaround
Override `all_to_all_4D` in `XpuCommunicator` to use `ft_c`.
